title: Disprove unconditional shift invariance
promptMarkdown: LetM pool a length-four vector by taking maxima over adjacent nonoverlapping pairs. Forx=(0,1,0,0) and the one-position circular right shiftTx=(0,0,1,0), calculateM(x), M(Tx), and decide whetherM is invariant. Give a concrete counterexample to linearity ofmax pooling. Then prove circular stride-one cross-correlation commutes with circular shifts, stating the modular-index convention.
hintLadder: Use two impulses in the same pooling window to test additivity.
Write the indices of both composed operators explicitly.
